metadata.short_desc: Mute users who repeat the same message; group-admin aware permissions and custom notice text
metadata.desc: Counts repeats of the same message within a time window and mutes when the threshold is reached. Thresholds, window, mute duration and the notice template can be configured from the plugin page, or overridden per group in QQ by group admins / bot admins via the /刷屏 commands.

same_message_only.description: Only count repeats of the same message
same_message_only.hint: On: trigger only when the same content repeats to the threshold. Off: any N messages in the window trigger

only_chat_messages.hint: When off, notice events (recall, admin changes, joins, poke, etc.) are counted too

max_messages.description: Repeats of the same message that trigger a mute
max_messages.hint: Triggers when reached; total message count when same_message_only is off

text_normalize.description: Ignore case and whitespace when comparing text

mute_seconds.hint: 0 means only count and notify, no real mute

notify.description: Send a notice in the group when triggered

manage_permission.description: Who may change this group's settings
manage_permission.hint: Controls /刷屏 阈值|窗口|禁言|提示|重置

manage_users.description: Extra user IDs allowed to manage this group

exempt_group_admins.hint: The bot usually cannot mute the group owner anyway
